cuerpo.name: Android v1.0.59-oss
cuerpo.body:
# What's New

### EPUB reader

- Added EPUB 3 media overlay narration to "Listen".

### Read-aloud & Listen

- Added transcript support for media overlay narration in the "Listen" overlay.
- Narration now resumes at the last heard passage instead of restarting from the beginning.
- Voice selections now apply audibly right away, including while playback is paused.
- Listen player opening is now separate from auto-start so it no longer jumps into playback.

### Library

- Added "search inside files": full-text search across your whole library, with per-file snippets and an expandable results view.
- Added a sort control to unified shelves.
- Implemented natural sorting for titles and file names (so "Book 2" comes before "Book 10").

### Reader appearance

- Added per-book local reader themes.

### Office documents

- Added support for legacy DOC files.
- Added native DOCX conversion through the office-oxide bridge.
- Shared the PPTX text indexer and rendering model across platforms.

### PDF reader

- Increased the maximum PDF zoom scale to 5000%.
- Opaque PDF ink strokes now keep their true color instead of rendering black.
- Centralized annotation export appearance and opacity so annotations look consistent on export.
- Undo and redo of PDF annotations are now persisted.
- The locked camera per PDF view is kept, so reopening restores it.

### Folder sync & data safety

- Fixed annotation data loss caused by sidecar race conditions and empty payloads.
- Folder sidecars now keep being written even when cloud sync is off.
- Hardened bookmark persistence against stale snapshot overwrites.

### Localization

- Removed stray zero-width spaces from Dutch, Ukrainian and Belarusian strings.

### Stability & performance

- Fixed OOM allocations and added a fallback for a missing WebView.
- Stopped offering the smart dictionary upsell in OSS builds.
- General app stability and performance improvements.

cuerpo.name: Android v1.0.58-oss
cuerpo.body:
# What's New

### New Look

- New app icon
- Library Beta is now the primary home screen

### EPUB

- Added support for EPUB 3 media overlays: books that ship the publisher's pre-recorded narration now play through the reader's audio session, with the narrated passage highlighted in step on both the paginated and vertical readers.
- Added a narration bar with play/pause, previous/next passage and a passage counter, plus playback speed control for media overlays.

### Read-aloud (TTS)

- Chunk source offsets are now tracked accurately, so the spoken sentence is highlighted where it actually is instead of drifting.
- Fixed webview TTS start position

### Highlights

- Custom highlight colors now support full ARGB, so a translucent color picked in the palette keeps its transparency on every surface instead of painting opaque.

### PDF reader

- Annotation saves are streamed instead of running as one blocking write, and maintenance queries were optimized.
- Fixed annotation popup padding, which could previously go negative.

### Other

- The in-app app icons is now repainted in the current app theme.
- General stability and performance improvements.

cuerpo.name: Android v1.0.57-oss
cuerpo.body:
# What's Changed

### Text-to-Speech & AI
* Added Fish Audio TTS integration and REST-based Cloud TTS.
* Added language filtering, favorite voices, and pre-generated audio sample previews for Cloud TTS.
* Added independent TTS voice settings for the Listen feature.
* Enabled BYOK (Bring-Your-Own-Key) AI model overrides across all online builds.
* Bypassed credit checks for BYOK AI and TTS features.

### PDF Reader & Annotations
* Added side-dock support for PDF annotation and text toolbars.
* Added paragraph alignment and bullet/numbered list support to PDF text boxes.
* Added action menu and position locking for PDF text boxes.
* Retired legacy page rich text editing on Android in favor of text box annotations.
* Improved PDF text box tap hit detection.
* Fixed PDF text box alignment, list toggle selection, and IME state handling.
* Fixed PDF two-page spread zoom tiling issues.
* Improved PDF tool dock overlap handling and side wheel scrolling.
* Optimized stroke drawing performance and gesture handling.

### Reader & UI Improvements
* Added right-to-left (RTL) pagination support for realistic page curls.
* Added support for bundled reader fonts.
* Added back button navigation to error states.
* Improved drawer sheet layout.

### Performance & Security
* Optimized app startup time and background workers.
* Optimized Compose UI performance, touch hit targets, and artwork loading.

cuerpo.name: Episteme Android v1.0.50-oss
cuerpo.body:
# Here is what is new in this update:

### Major Changes
* **Continuous Vertical Scrolling** 
  The EPUB reader now features a continuous vertical scrolling variation. It runs on the same custom engine that handles pagination, allowing you to scroll seamlessly through an entire file without breaking pages.
  > reader screen > more > reading mode > vertical (native)
* **Temporary External File Viewing**
  We added a "Temporary" option for external file behavior. When opening a file from an email or external file manager, it will open a standalone instance of the reader. This allows you to read the document without permanently adding it to your app storage.
  > home > more > external file behavior > temporary
* **Visual Word Replacement**
  Added a new feature that allows you to visually replace specific words directly within the text of the books you are reading.
  > reader screen > more > book word replacement

### Improvements & Additions
* **CBT Support:** Added full support for reading CBT files.
* **Better Custom Fonts:** You can now select multiple font files at once from the file picker when importing. The app also now detects and properly uses font file variations.
* **Quick Share & Save:** You can now easily share or save any file directly from the home screen or library by long-pressing the item.
* **Fixes:** Addressed several underlying bugs and crashes to improve overall stability.

cuerpo.name: Desktop v1.0.1
cuerpo.body:
## What's New

Episteme Reader desktop builds are now available for Linux.

### Standard vs OSS

The standard build is the full-featured desktop version. It may include proprietary libraries or service-backed features such as AI, cloud sync, online font downloads, OPDS/catalog features, and account-based functionality.

The OSS build is fully offline and open-source focused. It does not include online/service-backed features such as OPDS, Google Fonts download, AI features, or cloud features.

### Downloads

- `episteme-standard-1.0.1-windows-x64.msi` - standard Windows build
- `episteme-oss-1.0.1-windows-x64.msi` - OSS/offline Windows build
- `episteme-standard-1.0.1-linux-amd64.deb` - Debian/Ubuntu build
- `episteme-oss-1.0.1-linux-amd64.deb` - OSS/offline Debian/Ubuntu build
- `episteme-standard-1.0.1-linux-x86_64.rpm` - Fedora/RPM build
- `episteme-oss-1.0.1-linux-x86_64.rpm` - OSS/offline Fedora/RPM build
- `episteme-bin-1.0.1-1-x86_64.pkg.tar.zst` - Arch package
- `episteme-oss-bin-1.0.1-1-x86_64.pkg.tar.zst` - OSS/offline Arch package

### Arch / AUR

Arch users can install from the AUR using an AUR helper such as `yay`:

```bash
yay -S episteme-bin
```
```bash
yay -S episteme-oss-bin

cuerpo.name: Windows v1.0.1
cuerpo.body:
# Here's What's New

Episteme Reader for Windows is now available for wider release.

This update focuses on making the Windows app feel much more complete, polished, and closer to the Android version.

## What's new

### Library overhaul

The library screen has been redesigned and improved for desktop use, with better organization, shelf management, folder handling, and smoother navigation.

### Reader overhaul

The reader screen has received a major UI/UX overhaul, with cleaner controls, improved navigation, better desktop interactions, and a more polished reading experience across formats.

### Google sign-in and cloud sync

Google sign-in is now available in the standard Windows version.

With sign-in, cloud sync is also available, including support for syncing your library, reading progress, bookmarks, highlights, and other reading data across devices.

### More features from Android

Several features from the Android app have been brought over to Windows, including better reader themes, more customization options, multiple reading modes, improved highlights and annotations, TTS improvements, and better support for desktop workflows.

### Stability and performance

This release also includes many performance, reliability, sync, and other improvements.

## Downloads

- `Episteme-1.0.1-x64.msi` — standard Windows build
- `Episteme.oss-1.0.1-x64.msi` — open-source Windows build

cuerpo.name: Episteme Windows v1.0.0-beta
cuerpo.body:
# Episteme for Windows (Beta)

This is the first public Windows beta release of Episteme.

This release includes MSI installers for both editions:

- **Episteme**
- **Episteme OSS**

## Editions

### Episteme

Episteme is the full edition of the app. It includes the same core reading experience as Episteme OSS, along with online and proprietary features.

### Episteme OSS

Episteme OSS is the open-source, offline-focused edition. It provides the core reading experience without online features or external service integrations.

The following online features are not available in Episteme OSS:

- Google Fonts
- OPDS

## Beta Notice

This is a beta release for Windows. Some platform-specific issues may still exist, and feedback is welcome.

Please report Windows-related bugs or installation issues through the project’s issue tracker.

## Installation

Download the MSI installer for the edition you want to use:

- Use the **Episteme** MSI for the full edition.
- Use the **Episteme OSS** MSI for the open-source offline edition.

cuerpo.name: Episteme v1.0.41-oss
cuerpo.body:
# Here's what's new

### Multi-Tab Reading
Added a multi-tab reading system for the PDF viewer, allowing you to keep multiple documents open and switch between them easily. 
*Note: To use this feature, you need to enable it by going to Homescreen > More > Enable Multi-Tab Reading.*

### Highlight Notes and Custom Colors
You can now attach text notes to your highlights in both EPUBs and PDFs. A new annotation bottom sheet has been added to enable this. Additionally, the PDF reader now supports custom highlight colors.

### PDF Improvements
* Zoom and pan states are now saved and remembered when pan lock is enabled.
* Fixed an issue that caused pages to jump when rotating the device in vertical reading mode.
* The eraser tool's hit detection is more accurate, and the annotation dock now supports horizontal scrolling.

### EPUB & FB2 Improvements
* Position saving in EPUBs is much more stable now.
* Better FB2 parsing: The app now properly retains footnotes and comments, correctly formats multiline titles, and supports poem and stanza tags.

### General App Changes
* File type badges have been added to the home and library screens.
* The file type filter dialog and the About screen have been redesigned.
* Improved bulk file import support and background folder synchronization.

cuerpo.name: Episteme v1.0.38-oss
cuerpo.body:
Here is what is new in this update:

### Custom Theme Engine
The EPUB reader now features a dedicated theme engine. You can choose from several presets, including Sepia, Slate, and OLED, or use the custom theme builder to set your own page and text colors.

### PDF Improvements
The vertical PDF reader has been updated with refined zoom logic and better orientation handling. Transitions between zoom levels are smoother, and page snapping is more reliable. Improved the way annotations are rendered and fixed position syncing when switching between reading modes.

### File and Folder Management
This version introduces more control over your library. You can now rename files directly and view enhanced file metadata. For those using folder synchronization, you can now filter which file types should be included. To keep the home screen organized, we have also added a limit to the number of recent files displayed.

### Stability and Fixes
- Resolved an issue causing duplicate text-to-speech audio in vertical mode.
- Improved the accuracy of text highlights and position tracking.
- Updated the text-to-speech playback order to prevent skipping or repeating sections.
- Added adjustable thickness for the annotation eraser tool.

cuerpo.name: Episteme v1.0.37-oss
cuerpo.body:
Here's what's new:

### Library and Organization
* **Book Pinning**: You can now pin your favorite books to the top of your Home and Library screens.
* **Advanced Filtering**: New filter chips allow you to sort your library by file type, and reading status (Unread, In Progress, or Completed).
* **Better Syncing**: Improved folder synchronization with a persistent status indicator so you know when your library is updating.

### Reading Features
* **Text-to-Speech(via text select)**: Select any text in an EPUB or PDF and have it read aloud.
* **External Tools**: Quick access to external translation and web search for selected text.
* **Improved Navigation**: The app now accurately preserves your reading position when switching between portrait and landscape modes.

### PDF Enhancements
* **Interactive Elements**: Added support for clickable buttons and widgets within PDF documents.
* **Annotations and Comments**: You can now view embedded PDF annotations, sticky notes, and reply threads directly in the viewer.
* **Better Reflow**: Replaced the old Markdown-based reflow with a new HTML generator. This provides much better layout preservation and handles images.
* **Enhanced Table of Contents**: The TOC now uses an expandable tree structure with a draggable scrollbar for easier navigation in long documents.
* **Visual Fixes**: Resolved issues with zoom stuttering and high-resolution rendering "bleeding" across page tiles.

### Performance and Stability
* **Memory Efficiency**: Optimized how large files are imported to reduce memory usage and prevent crashes.
* **Background Processing**: Heavy PDF operations like text extraction and search are now handled in the background for a smoother UI experience.
* **Data Integrity**: Implemented a more reliable saving mechanism for bookmarks, highlights, and scroll positions.

cuerpo.name: Episteme v1.0.36-oss
cuerpo.body:
Here's what's new:

- **Native PDF Reflow**: The reflow engine has been completely rebuilt. This makes generating text views of PDFs faster and allows for a seamless transition between the original PDF and the reflowed text view without losing your spot.

- **Interactive PDF Highlighting**: You can now select text in PDFs to highlight it, change colors via a new selection menu, or delete existing highlights just like in the EPUB reader.

- **Highlighter Snapping**: Added a "Straight Line" toggle for PDF annotations. This allows you to draw perfectly straight highlights that snap to horizontal or vertical axes.

- **Offline Dictionary Support**: A new dictionary settings dialog has been added, supporting external apps like Aard2 and Android's system-wide "Process Text" actions for looking up words.

- **Multi-Folder Syncing**: Expanded the folder sync feature to support up to three separate local folders simultaneously.

- **Enhanced EPUB Borders**: The pagination engine now correctly renders individual CSS border sides and border-radius.

- **Performance & Fixes**: Fixed main-thread stutters when browsing the library, improved background sync reliability for annotations, and added cache cleanup when deleting books.

cuerpo.name: Episteme v1.0.35-oss
cuerpo.body:
Here's what's new in this update:

###  Musician Mode
We’ve added a dedicated mode for music sheets. It features regions to go back or skip sections and app bars are hidden to reduce distractions.

###  PDF Text Reflow
Tired of squinting at PDFs? You can now toggle "Reflow Mode," which converts PDF content into a clean, readable Markdown format. It processes in the background and handles large files smoothly without slowing down the app.

###  Themed Icons & UI
The app now supports monochrome icons to match your system theme.

###  Folder Annotation Sync
Your PDF annotations are now kept in sync with your folders, making it easier to manage your notes across different sessions.

### Performance & General Fixes
- Optimized EPUB parsing so books open much faster.
- Fixed a bug where reading positions wouldn't save correctly for TXT and MD files.
- Resolved several crashes and page layout mismatches.
- Reduced memory usage when handling large documents.

cuerpo.name: Episteme v1.0.34-oss
cuerpo.body:
# Here's what's new in this update:

* **Enhanced Auto-Scroll:** You can now toggle auto-scroll with a tap if its on screen. We’ve also added "Local" speed profiles, meaning the app can remember your preferred scroll speed for each individual book. The controls also got a visual refresh.

* **Stylus-Only Annotation Mode:** For PDF annotations, there is a new toggle in the annotation dock. When enabled, only your stylus will draw on the page, while your fingers remain dedicated to scrolling and navigation.
 
* **Upgraded Text-to-Speech:** We’ve added a new voice settings option. You can now browse, filter, and preview different system voices through a new settings sheet to find the perfect narrator for your books.
 
* **Realistic EPUB Animations:** Added a new option for page-turn animation for a more natural reading feel. You can also now use your device's volume buttons to flip through pages in paginated mode.

cuerpo.name: Local folder sync
cuerpo.body:
Here's what's new in this version:

### 📁 Local Folder Sync
We’ve added a new way to manage your library by linking folders directly from your device storage.
* **Syncing Folders:** When you link a folder, the app now supports local metadata synchronization. This tracks your progress and bookmarks within that folder so you can stay in sync across devices without moving your files.
* **Standard Imports:** The original option to import books directly into the app's internal storage is still available and works exactly as it did before.
* **Background Extraction:** Book covers and metadata are now processed in the background, keeping the app snappy while it organizes your library.
* **Pull-to-Refresh:** You can now manually trigger a sync for folder books' metadata directly from the home screen.

### 📖 Enhanced Reading Experience
* **PDF Pan Lock:** Tired of the page sliding sideways? Use the new lock icon(in top app bar) to restrict movement to vertical scrolling only.
* **Auto-Scroll Limits:** You can now set minimum and maximum speed bounds for a more controlled auto-reading experience.
* **Better Bookmarks:** Navigating to bookmarks in EPUBs is now much more reliable, featuring a loading overlay for long jumps to ensure the page renders correctly.

### 🛠️ Performance & Stability
* **Memory Optimizations:** Fixed several "Out of Memory" crashes related to large image files in EPUBs and long-running Text-to-Speech sessions.
* **Lazy Loading:** Images are now loaded only when they appear on screen, significantly reducing the app's memory footprint.

### 🎨 UI Improvements
* **Refreshed Library:** A cleaner interface for managing your collection.
* **Edge-to-Edge:** Improved support for modern displays with better padding and navigation bar transparency.

cuerpo.name: Episteme Reader v1.0.31-oss (Initial OSS Release)
cuerpo.body:
## 🚀 Initial Open Source Release (v1.0.31-oss)

Welcome to the first official Open Source release of **Episteme Reader**! This version is a flavor of the main application, modified to be fully compliant with open-source standards.

### 🌟 Key Features
- **Privacy First:** No tracking, no telemetry.
- **Clean Build:** All proprietary components and non-free dependencies from the main app have been removed or replaced.

### 🛠 Changes in the OSS Flavor
Compared to the standard version, this OSS flavor:
- Removes proprietary AI Worker and Verifier endpoints (as seen in `buildConfigFields`).
- Disables Pro-only features to ensure a completely free experience.

### 📦 Installation
1. Download the `Episteme-oss-v1.0.31-oss-release.apk` attached below.
3. Enable "Install from Unknown Sources" in your Android settings to install.
